---
title: "Slides"
listing:
  # Recursive by default, hence the negation: tests/ are kit fixtures, not decks.
  contents: ["*.qmd", "!tests/**"]
  type: grid
  sort: "date desc"
  fields: [image, date, title, description]
  # Quarto cannot auto-extract a preview from a Reveal.js deck (it looks for
  # `main.content`, which a deck has no such thing as), so cards fall back to
  # this unless a deck sets its own `image:`.
  image-placeholder: assets/swirl-dark.jpg
page-layout: full
---

Every deck in this project. Each card opens the Reveal.js version; the editable
PowerPoint is in `reports/`.
